name: Billa Marktküche
kurzbeschreibung:
**Discover the freshest flavors of Tirol at Billa Marktküche!**

Indulge in regional specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn**, hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**, or a juicy **Schweinsbraten** with **Krautsalat**—all made with the finest local ingredients. Whether you're craving a quick snack or a hearty meal, our **Marktküche** offers something for everyone.

Located right in the heart of **Innsbruck**, we’re your perfect stop for authentic **Tiroler** tastes. Come by for a delicious bite and experience the true flavors of the Alps!
